entries.title: Swipe through a guide
entries.text: Swipe sideways to change tabs, and from the first tab back to your guides.

entries.title: Stats behind the profile button
entries.text: Your stats now open from the profile button at the top of the start page and of every guide.

entries.title: Limits in the chips
entries.text: A missed True Defense or Magical Power limit now shows as a red value in its chip.

entries.title: Source and coins left
entries.text: Each guide links its source again and shows the coins left to the end of the chapter and section.

entries.title: Your guides in their own app
entries.text: Follow your guides step by step, see the best value and compare your stats, each guide in its own colours.
